title: Add a kebab-case helper to a Python module that already cleans text
prompt: In src/fmt.py, add a function kebab(text) that returns the text in kebab-case for file names: cleaned like the module already cleans text, with every run of non-alphanumeric characters replaced by a single hyphen and no leading or trailing hyphen ('  Hello,  World! ' -> 'hello-world'). Tests run with: pytest -q
